title: Matte Black Towel Bar, 18-Inch Wall Mount Solid Brass Straight Bar, Carolina Collection, Allied Brass
description: Finished in Matte Black, towel bar with 18-inch center-to-center length for bathroom towel storage, made from solid brass with a straight bar design and traditional style, which makes a bold, modern statement with its sleek, non-reflective surface that anchors contemporary bathroom designs. Wall mount installation with concealed screw mounting hardware creates a clean, finished look and saves space. Includes towel bar, mounting plates, and all installation hardware; no assembly required. Bar diameter is 0.75 in; projection (depth) is 2 in; overall height is 3.5 in. Supports up to 10 lb. Designed as classic bath accessories and traditional bathroom hardware for matching Carolina bathrooms; available in many designer finishes. Limited Lifetime Warranty. Allied Brass Carolina collection.
